# Laravel TableKit branding

These assets use the blue and cool-gray palette of the sibling Laravel
Rulecraft project. The TableKit mark combines a letter T with a table grid.

- [logo.png](logo.png): square logo with transparent background and cutouts.
- [social-preview.png](social-preview.png): full-resolution 2:1 PNG master.
- [social-preview.jpg](social-preview.jpg): 2:1 JPEG for GitHub social previews.
- [PROMPTS.md](PROMPTS.md): generation prompts and reference details.

The reference palette is blue `#28518D`, navy `#25313D`, pale blue
`#A8C7F5`, and cool gray `#EDF0F3`. Images are generated raster assets, so
individual pixels may vary slightly from these colors.

To set the social preview, upload the JPEG under **Repository settings →
General → Social preview → Edit → Upload an image**. Adding the banner to
the README does not change the repository's social preview automatically.
